{{Quote|I have three bounties on Lok I haven't had a chance to collect. You take care of them for me, and I'll split the bounty with you. An associate of mine, named Balfur, has been tracking them.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BBP" />}}
'''Balfur Jhcor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Bossk let me know that you were on your way. I have the information you'll need for each of the bounties. I'll upload it to your journal. Now, get to work. When you finish with these bounties, I can finally get off of this forsaken planet.|Balfur Jhcor, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BBP" />}}
[[File:Balfur.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Balfur Jhcor on Lok.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Balfur Jhcor was associated with [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], a fellow Trandoshan bounty hunter.<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Balfur and Bossk identified three notable [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]: [[Joti Laike]], [[Sardeya Elgrin]] and [[Oono Mor'in]]. Balfur tracked them and localized them while Bossk was stuck on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> tracking the [[Bofa Treat Gang]].<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bountied!|Corellia}}</ref> Bossk encountered a skilled spacer on Corellia who accepted to help Balfur collect the bounties. The spacer traveled to Lok and met Balfur Jhcor near [[Nym's Stronghold]]. The spacer then tracked the three bounties and successfully eliminated all of them. In the meantime, Bossk convinced Balfur to murder the spacer in order not to share the bounties. When the spacer returned to Balfur, the bounty hunter attacked the adventurer but the latter managed to defeat the Trandoshan. Balfur apologized for letting Bossk manipulated him and decided to resign for being a bounty hunter. The Trandoshan also gave all his wapons to the spacer.<ref name="SWG:BBP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balfur Jhcor was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Balfur Jhcor was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
